interop.note: One-off check, 2026-11-25: every ciphertext this implementation made for the recorded vectors was decrypted by real Node v24.18.1 in docker to the original message (the four 'expectedFailure' rows are privateEncrypt of an empty message, which Node's publicDecrypt refuses for its own output too), and the deterministic outputs (privateEncrypt, RSA_NO_PADDING) equal Node's byte for byte. The checker script is under `interop.checker` of node-crypto-sign.controls.json.
